{{Quote|Those rodders? Thieves and killers, every one of them! I'll die before I see them take a millimeter of Dimok land!|[[Unidentified Dimok crone|A Dimok crone]], referring to the Ripoblus|<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
The '''Ripoblus''', colloquially known as the '''Rips''',<ref name="TEGtW" /> were a cultural group of the [[Sepan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to [[Ripoblus/Legends|Ripoblus]],<ref name="TFCCD:TOSG" /> one of the two primary [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|101|Ripoblus}}</ref>

The Ripoblus were involved with the [[Dimok (people)|people]] of [[Dimok/Legends|Dimok]] in the [[Sepan Civil War]], a conflict which lasted intermittently for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|jediwatch/13328_2.html|Sepan Civil War Escalates}}</ref><ref name="TF">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref><ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref><ref name="TEGtW" />
